mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recharge ( id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, username VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, payment_method VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'PENDING', order_no VARCHAR(64) UNIQUE NOT NULL, create_time TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, remark TEXT, INDEX idx_username (username), INDEX idx_order_no (order_no), INDEX idx_status (status) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recharge(username, amount, payment_method, status, order_no, create_time, remark) VALUES(#{username}, #{amount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{status}, #{orderNo}, NOW(), #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, amount, payment_method, status, order_no, create_time, update_time, remark FROM recharge WHERE username = #{username} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 50
